subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5
solution:
The correct answer is **‘nurture’**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage describes how the Center for Climate Justice works closely with indigenous communities.
 
• The word needed should indicate building, supporting, or strengthening relationships.
 
• **“Nurture”** means to support, develop, and strengthen — which perfectly fits the context of building relationships.
 
• Other options like **notice**, **imitate**, and **nominate** do not convey the meaning of developing meaningful partnerships.

Therefore, the correct answer is **‘Option 3’**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Notice** — means to observe; does not fit the context.
 
• **Imitate** — means to copy; not relevant here.
 
• **Nominate** — means to propose someone for a position; incorrect in this context.
